Market today: The mood is cautious. Fed rate hike talk and rising interest rates are the real drivers, directly hurting your tech/chip heavy, margin-fueled portfolio. Consumer strength headlines don't offset this. 

Your holdings: QQQ (-8.08%), SMH (-27.7%), and SOXL (-78.17%) are all in SELL status with significant losses. Given your margin use, these drawdowns are amplified and need close attention. 

Watch: Keep a close eye on Fed commentary and interest rate movements. Also, monitor any news around AI chip demand, especially given the US-China tensions impacting data centers. 

Bottom line: The macro environment is challenging for your concentrated, leveraged tech book; risk management is paramount.
plays: Re-evaluate your SOXL stop loss immediately; it's down 78.17% and the current stop at 200 is far above the price of 49.07. This position needs urgent risk management.
Consider trimming some CRWD. It's up 25.52% and marked TRIM, offering a chance to take profits and reduce overall portfolio risk.
Watch SOXS for a potential hedge against chip weakness. Scanner shows a WATCH setup at entry 58.71-58.65, stop 58.16.
